game.name: House of the Dragon S3 Finale Draft — Signature Beats
game.design_target_used: Most cards intentionally land at 65–75 points so headline totals do not recreate a ranking.
game.character_beat_model: Draft character → choose exactly 3 of 5 candidate Signature Beats to activate.
game.character_card_value_rule: Card value is the maximum achievable scoring path (anchor + one result from each fork), not the raw sum of all five visible beats.
game.why: This preserves the 60–90 value band while showing opposing story directions and preventing five visible beats from mechanically inflating every card above 100 points.
game.character_card_headline_after_activation: Show the sum of the 3 activated beats as Points at Stake.
game.character_card_total_rule: Never sum all five beats on the draft card. Only the player's three activated beats define their available signature score.
game.selection_strategy: Players choose both a character and a prediction portfolio for that character.
game.activation_rule: Every drafted character activates exactly 3 beats before the episode.
game.design_goal_v4: Main characters receive more candidate directions and broader relationship coverage; support characters remain tighter and easier to scan.

excluded: Unaired Fire & Blood outcomes in trigger text
spoiler_policy.odds_note: Estimated probability percentages are subjective game-design reads based only on on-screen setup through E7. They are not calibrated forecasts and are not derived from leaks.

grouping_sanity_check.recommendation: Keep draft_group separate from allegiance and house/origin. The current buckets mix faction, geography, and bloodline.

minimal_changes_if_ui_categories_must_st.reason: She is a Green royal/noncombatant being held in Black-controlled King's Landing; captivity does not make her Black.
He is Northern by House, but by E7 his active role is Rhaenyra's Master of Coin in the Black court.
His current service is at the court in Black-held King's Landing, but he is not best described as an ideological Black.

rename_recommendations.reason: Hugh and Ulf are dragonseeds; Kat is Hugh's civilian wife and is not a dragonseed.
Corlys is House Velaryon, while Addam and Alyn are his unlegitimized sons; the grouping is narratively useful but not literally a shared House status.

acceptable_as_is: House Hightower (as a story/army bucket; Bold Jon is an operative, not a Hightower by blood)
The North and Riverlands for Roderick Dustin, Oscar Tully, and Alysanne Blackwood

characters.name: Daemon Targaryen

signature_beats.name: Caraxes Sortie
signature_beats.trigger: Daemon mounts Caraxes and deliberately enters an active combat, pursuit, or interception scene.
signature_beats.pitch: The Blood Wyrm is still Daemon's most reliable argument.

signature_beats.name: Makes Peace
signature_beats.trigger: Daemon and Rhaenyra explicitly reconcile, forgive one another, or reaffirm that they are acting together.
signature_beats.pitch: The terrifying power couple gets functional again.

signature_beats.name: Defies the Queen
signature_beats.trigger: Daemon knowingly disobeys or circumvents a direct instruction from Rhaenyra.
signature_beats.pitch: Or he remembers that obedience has never been his brand.

signature_beats.name: Protects Rhaena
signature_beats.trigger: Daemon takes a concrete action that shields Rhaena from punishment, capture, or immediate physical danger.
signature_beats.pitch: The murder prince scores through dad mode.

signature_beats.name: Hands Her Over
signature_beats.trigger: Daemon voluntarily surrenders Rhaena to Rhaenyra's custody or supports a punishment Rhaenyra imposes on her.
signature_beats.pitch: The brutal branch: crown over daughter.

signature_beats.name: Baela Heart-to-Heart
signature_beats.trigger: Daemon and Baela have a private conversation in which either one directly discusses Jace, Rhaena, or their family relationship.
signature_beats.pitch: One real father-daughter scene would suddenly matter a lot.

signature_beats.name: Faces Aemond
signature_beats.trigger: Daemon and Aemond directly see, address, or attack one another in the present timeline.
signature_beats.pitch: Two of the show's most dangerous men finally share the same problem.

activation_model.selection_timing: Activate three beats after drafting the character and before the episode begins.

characters.draft_pitch: You are betting on which Daemon wins: husband or rebel, father or prince.

characters.name: Rhaenyra Targaryen

signature_beats.name: Orders Dragonfire
signature_beats.trigger: Rhaenyra explicitly orders a dragon or dragonrider to burn an enemy, force, fortification, or named target.
signature_beats.pitch: The queen stops managing the crisis and chooses fire.

signature_beats.name: Makes Peace
signature_beats.trigger: Rhaenyra and Daemon explicitly reconcile, forgive one another, or reaffirm that they are acting together.
signature_beats.pitch: You are betting the royal marriage survives its latest civil war.

signature_beats.name: Punishes Daemon
signature_beats.trigger: Rhaenyra orders Daemon confined, stripped of authority, arrested, or otherwise formally punished.
signature_beats.pitch: The marriage becomes a constitutional crisis.

signature_beats.name: Sapphic Spark
signature_beats.trigger: Rhaenyra and Mysaria share an unmistakably romantic or sexual interaction in the present timeline.
signature_beats.pitch: The politics stop for one very specific kind of diplomacy.

signature_beats.name: Pushes Mysaria Away
signature_beats.trigger: Rhaenyra explicitly rejects Mysaria's intimacy, removes her from confidence, or tells her their relationship cannot continue.
signature_beats.pitch: You are betting the favorite adviser becomes the favorite scapegoat.

signature_beats.name: Protects Helaena
signature_beats.trigger: Rhaenyra takes a concrete action to protect Helaena or Jaehaera from another character's threat or demand.
signature_beats.pitch: The claimant becomes protector of the rival queen's family.

signature_beats.name: Punishes Rhaena
signature_beats.trigger: Rhaenyra imposes or orders a concrete punishment on Rhaena for Sheepstealer, Jace, or disobedience.
signature_beats.pitch: Family grief finally turns into royal discipline.

activation_model.selection_timing: Activate three beats after drafting the character and before the episode begins.

characters.draft_pitch: Two clean forks: repair or rupture with Daemon; trust or crack down on the dragonseeds.

characters.name: Helaena Targaryen
characters.allegiance_note: Green family; noncombatant captive/ward in Black-held King's Landing

signature_beats.name: Cryptic Warning
signature_beats.trigger: Helaena says a clearly prophetic or ominous line about something that has not yet happened in the episode.
signature_beats.pitch: One strange sentence can become the whole night's clue.

signature_beats.name: Protects Jaehaera
signature_beats.trigger: Helaena takes a concrete action to hide, move, defend, or secure Jaehaera from a perceived threat.
signature_beats.pitch: Her agency pays when she chooses her daughter over everybody's plans.

signature_beats.name: Leaves With Alicent
signature_beats.trigger: Helaena voluntarily leaves Black custody with Alicent or agrees on screen to escape with her.
signature_beats.pitch: Mother and daughter finally choose flight together.

signature_beats.name: Refuses to Run
signature_beats.trigger: Helaena directly refuses Alicent or another rescuer's request that she flee King's Landing.
signature_beats.pitch: Her agency can also mean staying exactly where everyone wants her gone.

signature_beats.name: Dreamfyre in Flesh
signature_beats.trigger: Helaena physically approaches, touches, mounts, or otherwise interacts with the real Dreamfyre in the present timeline.
signature_beats.pitch: The vision becomes real.

signature_beats.name: Refuses Dreamfyre
signature_beats.trigger: Someone urges Helaena to use or ride Dreamfyre and Helaena explicitly refuses.
signature_beats.pitch: She can score by rejecting dragon power just as clearly as embracing it.

signature_beats.name: Warns Rhaenyra
signature_beats.trigger: Helaena directly gives Rhaenyra a prophetic warning, prediction, or cryptic statement about danger to come.
signature_beats.pitch: The rival queen becomes the audience for the realm's strangest weather report.

activation_model.selection_timing: Activate three beats after drafting the character and before the episode begins.

characters.draft_pitch: Helaena is a genuine choose-your-own-prophecy card: flee or stay, embrace the dragon or reject it.

characters.name: Baela Targaryen

signature_beats.name: Moondancer Sortie
signature_beats.trigger: Baela mounts Moondancer and flies on an active mission, pursuit, reconnaissance, or battle sortie.
signature_beats.pitch: The dragonrider actually gets deployed.

signature_beats.name: Comforts Rhaena
signature_beats.trigger: Baela explicitly comforts, defends, or reassures Rhaena over Sheepstealer or Jace.
signature_beats.pitch: Sister solidarity pays.

signature_beats.name: Calls Out Rhaena
signature_beats.trigger: Baela directly criticizes Rhaena for Sheepstealer, Jace, or a dangerous choice she made.
signature_beats.pitch: Or sister solidarity finally reaches its limit.

signature_beats.name: Kisses Alyn Again
signature_beats.trigger: Baela and Alyn share another unmistakably romantic kiss.
signature_beats.pitch: The Velaryon romance survives the war for at least one scene.

signature_beats.name: Ends It With Alyn
signature_beats.trigger: Baela explicitly rejects, ends, or walks back her romantic relationship with Alyn.
signature_beats.pitch: You are betting on war beating romance.

signature_beats.name: Challenges Rhaenyra
signature_beats.trigger: Baela directly challenges or refuses a decision by Rhaenyra involving Rhaena, Alyn, or the Velaryons.
signature_beats.pitch: She stops being only a loyal niece and pushes back.

activation_model.selection_timing: Activate three beats after drafting the character and before the episode begins.

characters.draft_pitch: Dragon action is the floor; the forks are sisterhood and romance.

characters.name: Mysaria

signature_beats.name: Intel Pays Off
signature_beats.trigger: Mysaria gives specific intelligence that directly causes Rhaenyra or another Black leader to change a plan or take action.
signature_beats.pitch: The spy network earns its screen time.

signature_beats.name: Sapphic Spark
signature_beats.trigger: Rhaenyra and Mysaria share an unmistakably romantic or sexual interaction in the present timeline.
signature_beats.pitch: The romance keeps moving.

signature_beats.name: Queen Pushes Away
signature_beats.trigger: Rhaenyra explicitly rejects Mysaria's intimacy, removes her from confidence, or tells her their relationship cannot continue.
signature_beats.pitch: The adviser becomes the scapegoat.

signature_beats.name: Turns the Queen
signature_beats.trigger: Mysaria persuades Rhaenyra to take a course of action Rhaenyra was resisting earlier in the same scene.
signature_beats.pitch: Pillow talk becomes policy.

signature_beats.name: Mysaria Exposed
signature_beats.trigger: A named character gives Rhaenyra concrete evidence that Mysaria concealed, manipulated, or misrepresented something important.
signature_beats.pitch: Influence becomes evidence against her.

signature_beats.name: Challenges Daemon
signature_beats.trigger: Mysaria directly opposes, threatens, or undermines Daemon in a conversation with him or in Rhaenyra's presence.
signature_beats.pitch: The queen's two most dangerous confidants collide.

activation_model.selection_timing: Activate three beats after drafting the character and before the episode begins.

characters.draft_pitch: Every Mysaria appearance becomes a referendum on whether influence is intimacy, power, or liability.

characters.name: Rhaena Targaryen

signature_beats.name: Rhaena Cries
signature_beats.trigger: Rhaena visibly cries or breaks down emotionally on screen.
signature_beats.pitch: Petty, clear, and extremely live-watchable.

signature_beats.name: Sheepstealer Returns
signature_beats.trigger: Rhaena physically reunites with Sheepstealer and the dragon allows her to approach or remain near him.
signature_beats.pitch: The feral boyfriend takes her back.

signature_beats.name: Sheepstealer Rejects
signature_beats.trigger: Rhaena tries to approach or command Sheepstealer and the dragon visibly avoids, ignores, or threatens her.
signature_beats.pitch: The people's dragon has boundaries.

signature_beats.name: Rhaena Redeems
signature_beats.trigger: Rhaena takes a deliberate action that directly saves a named ally from serious danger.
signature_beats.pitch: One heroic choice could erase a lot of yelling at the television.

signature_beats.name: Bad Idea Again
signature_beats.trigger: Rhaena knowingly makes a choice that immediately creates a new danger or materially worsens an existing crisis.
signature_beats.pitch: One last 'RHAENA, WHY?'

signature_beats.name: Confronts Rhaenyra
signature_beats.trigger: Rhaena directly argues with Rhaenyra about Sheepstealer, Jace, punishment, or her right to make her own choices.
signature_beats.pitch: The child finally argues back at the queen.

activation_model.selection_timing: Activate three beats after drafting the character and before the episode begins.

characters.draft_pitch: The cleanest hate-watch card: dragon acceptance vs rejection, redemption vs one more terrible decision.

characters.name: Grand Maester Orwyle
characters.allegiance_note: Court-serving / effectively neutral; not ideologically Black

signature_beats.name: Royal Treatment
signature_beats.trigger: Orwyle personally examines, treats, or prescribes medicine for Helaena, Jaehaera, Rhaenyra, or another named royal.
signature_beats.pitch: A tiny doctor scene gives the sleeper pick a real floor.

signature_beats.name: Smuggles Helaena
signature_beats.trigger: Orwyle knowingly helps Helaena or Jaehaera escape, hide from, or bypass Black custody.
signature_beats.pitch: One quiet maester scene could swing the pick.

signature_beats.name: Exposes a Poison
signature_beats.trigger: Orwyle identifies or directly reveals that a named character has been poisoned or drugged.
signature_beats.pitch: The medical guy gets to solve the dangerous medical problem.

signature_beats.name: Helps Alicent
signature_beats.trigger: Orwyle knowingly gives Alicent information, medicine, or access that helps her evade or oppose Black authority.
signature_beats.pitch: Old court loyalties become a scoring event.

signature_beats.name: Defies Mysaria
signature_beats.trigger: Orwyle explicitly refuses, conceals information from, or works around an instruction from Mysaria.
signature_beats.pitch: The maester and the spymaster quietly disagree over who runs the castle.

activation_model.selection_timing: Activate three beats after drafting the character and before the episode begins.

characters.draft_pitch: A true sleeper card: doctor by default, conspirator or whistleblower if the plot turns.

characters.name: Aemond Targaryen

signature_beats.name: Aemond Wakes
signature_beats.trigger: Aemond clearly regains consciousness and becomes mentally responsive after Alicent's poisoning.
signature_beats.pitch: The first sweat is simply whether he gets back in the game.

signature_beats.name: Calls Out Alicent
signature_beats.trigger: Aemond directly accuses or confronts Alicent about poisoning or betraying him.
signature_beats.pitch: The mother-son disaster finally becomes a conversation.

signature_beats.name: Forgives Alicent
signature_beats.trigger: After learning she poisoned him, Aemond explicitly forgives Alicent or refuses an opportunity to punish her.
signature_beats.pitch: The most shocking branch is mercy.

signature_beats.name: Finds Vhagar
signature_beats.trigger: A conscious Aemond physically reunites with Vhagar in the present timeline.
signature_beats.pitch: One eye plus one enormous dragon means power is restored.

signature_beats.name: Chooses Alys
signature_beats.trigger: A conscious Aemond explicitly chooses to remain with, trust, or follow Alys instead of immediately leaving Harrenhal.
signature_beats.pitch: The Harrenhal relationship beats the war for one more scene.

signature_beats.name: Rejects Alys
signature_beats.trigger: A conscious Aemond explicitly rejects Alys's advice, protection, or intimacy and chooses to leave her behind.
signature_beats.pitch: The spell breaks.

signature_beats.name: Targets Aegon
signature_beats.trigger: Aemond explicitly makes finding, killing, capturing, or taking revenge on Aegon an immediate objective.
signature_beats.pitch: Sibling rivalry becomes strategic priority.

activation_model.selection_timing: Activate three beats after drafting the character and before the episode begins.

characters.draft_pitch: Recovery is the anchor; then you are betting on vengeance vs mercy and war vs Alys.

characters.name: Alicent Hightower
characters.allegiance_note: Green-origin; acting independently to protect Helaena

signature_beats.name: Protects Helaena
signature_beats.trigger: Alicent takes a concrete action intended to secure Helaena or Jaehaera's safety.
signature_beats.pitch: Whatever Alicent becomes, Helaena remains the motive.

signature_beats.name: Saves Aemond
signature_beats.trigger: Alicent actively seeks an antidote, healer, or other intervention intended to keep Aemond alive after poisoning him.
signature_beats.pitch: The assassin arc turns instantly into mother panic.

signature_beats.name: Leaves Him Dying
signature_beats.trigger: Alicent knowingly leaves an incapacitated Aemond without seeking help when she has a clear opportunity to do so.
signature_beats.pitch: She commits to the choice all the way.

signature_beats.name: Returns to Rhaenyra
signature_beats.trigger: Alicent voluntarily returns to Rhaenyra's custody or presence to report what happened with Aemond.
signature_beats.pitch: She finishes the bargain she started.

signature_beats.name: Runs From the Deal
signature_beats.trigger: Alicent deliberately avoids returning to Rhaenyra and takes action to escape or hide from the Blacks instead.
signature_beats.pitch: She decides she has honored enough bargains for one lifetime.

signature_beats.name: Finds Aegon
signature_beats.trigger: Alicent and Aegon physically reunite and exchange dialogue in the present timeline.
signature_beats.pitch: The son she betrayed and the mother who lost control finally share a room.

signature_beats.name: Asks Helaena Forgive
signature_beats.trigger: Alicent explicitly asks Helaena to forgive her for a decision involving Helaena, Aemond, Aegon, or the war.
signature_beats.pitch: Maternal guilt finally gets said aloud.

activation_model.selection_timing: Activate three beats after drafting the character and before the episode begins.

characters.draft_pitch: Alicent's card is built entirely from consequences: save or abandon Aemond, honor or flee Rhaenyra's bargain.

characters.name: Alys Rivers
characters.allegiance_note: Harrenhal / personally tied to Aemond; not cleanly factional

signature_beats.name: Alys Witchcraft
signature_beats.trigger: Alys performs or causes something the episode presents as supernatural, prophetic, impossible, or overtly magical.
signature_beats.pitch: If Harrenhal gets weird, you get paid.

signature_beats.name: Saves Aemond
signature_beats.trigger: Alys actively treats, rescues, or otherwise prevents Aemond from dying from the poisoning or its immediate consequences.
signature_beats.pitch: He is now her most valuable patient.

signature_beats.name: Lets Poison Work
signature_beats.trigger: Alys clearly realizes Aemond is poisoned and deliberately refuses or withholds help that she could provide.
signature_beats.pitch: The witch decides fate has spoken.

signature_beats.name: Uses the Eggs
signature_beats.trigger: Alys physically moves, reveals, gives away, hides elsewhere, or invokes the hidden dragon eggs as part of a concrete plan.
signature_beats.pitch: The season's weirdest stash finally becomes actionable.

signature_beats.name: Keeps Eggs Hidden
signature_beats.trigger: Alys is directly asked about dragons or eggs and knowingly conceals the hidden clutch.
signature_beats.pitch: The secret survives the finale intact.

signature_beats.name: Faces Alicent
signature_beats.trigger: Alys and Alicent directly confront one another about Aemond, the poisoning, or who controls what happens to him next.
signature_beats.pitch: Two very different women with claims on Aemond finally collide.

activation_model.selection_timing: Activate three beats after drafting the character and before the episode begins.

characters.draft_pitch: Magic is guaranteed-ish; her two forks are whether she saves Aemond and whether the eggs enter the game.

characters.name: Aegon II Targaryen

signature_beats.name: Aegon Sass
signature_beats.trigger: Aegon delivers an unmistakably sarcastic, cutting, morbidly funny, or self-aware line.
signature_beats.pitch: Your safest payout is that Aegon remains Aegon.

signature_beats.name: Flies Sunfyre
signature_beats.trigger: Aegon mounts Sunfyre and the two become airborne together in the present timeline.
signature_beats.pitch: The comeback becomes physical.

signature_beats.name: Stays Grounded
signature_beats.trigger: Aegon has a clear opportunity to flee or move with Sunfyre and explicitly chooses to remain on the ground.
signature_beats.pitch: The broken king chooses stubbornness over escape.

signature_beats.name: Claims the Throne
signature_beats.trigger: Aegon explicitly makes retaking the Iron Throne or being recognized as king his immediate objective.
signature_beats.pitch: The political branch: crown first.

signature_beats.name: Chooses Aemond
signature_beats.trigger: Aegon explicitly makes finding, killing, or taking revenge on Aemond his immediate priority over Rhaenyra or the throne.
signature_beats.pitch: The personal branch: brother first.

signature_beats.name: Trusts Tyland
signature_beats.trigger: Aegon accepts and follows a consequential plan proposed by Tyland after Tyland explains the plan to him.
signature_beats.pitch: The king finally takes advice from the unexpectedly competent Lannister.

signature_beats.name: Takes Larys Back
signature_beats.trigger: After Larys's episode-7 departure, Aegon physically reunites with him and explicitly accepts his help or counsel again.
signature_beats.pitch: The strangest buddy relationship gets renewed.

activation_model.selection_timing: Activate three beats after drafting the character and before the episode begins.

characters.draft_pitch: Aegon's forks are wonderfully clean: fly or stand; throne or brother.

signature_beats.pitch: The weirdest buddy comedy gets an encore.

signature_beats.name: Sells Out Aegon

signature_beats.pitch: Self-preservation beats loyalty.

signature_beats.name: Warns Aegon

signature_beats.name: Deals With Enemy
signature_beats.trigger: Larys knowingly bargains with a Black or Hightower-aligned opponent for his own safety or advancement.

signature_beats.name: Pressures Tyland

activation_model.selection_timing: Activate three beats after drafting the character and before the episode begins.

characters.name: Tyland Lannister

signature_beats.pitch: The supporting character gets to be the competent one.

signature_beats.pitch: The two surviving schemers finally stop politely sharing a wagon.

characters.name: Ormund Hightower

design_notes_v2.fork_locking: When one beat in a fork triggers, award it and permanently lock the other beat in that same fork. The anchor remains independent.
design_notes_v2.host_behavior: The console should show the locked sibling as unavailable immediately after the first branch scores.
design_notes_v2.draft_behavior: All five possibilities can be shown on the draft card. Display the maximum scoring path as the card value; do not sum all five badge values.
design_notes_v2.opposite_direction_goal: Each character has at least one meaningful branch where the story can move in opposing directions: loyalty/betrayal, reconciliation/conflict, escape/stay, power/restraint, family/duty, etc.
design_notes_v2.stacking: Collision beats may still stack with signature beats unless the app chooses otherwise.

activation_rules.why_allow_hedging: Using two activation slots on opposite outcomes raises the chance of one payout but reduces breadth and maximum upside elsewhere.
activation_rules.collision_beats: Remain separate and can stack with activated signature beats.
activation_rules.dragon_rules: Unchanged from v2; dragon signature beats remain automatically live because each dragon has only 1–2 bespoke beats.

v4_second_pass_notes.main_change: Central characters now have 7 candidates and major supporting characters 6, while support picks remain at 5.
v4_second_pass_notes.relationship_rule: Central characters were rewritten to touch at least four distinct relationship/story axes where plausible.
v4_second_pass_notes.rhaenyra_specific: Rhaenyra now has dragonfire plus separate bets involving Daemon, Mysaria, Helaena/Jaehaera, and Rhaena.
v4_second_pass_notes.point_balance: Every possible three-beat activation combination for every character remains between 60 and 90 base points.
